greek-fire-constantinople.research_focus: 7th-century Byzantine dromon warships, the bronze siphon tubes used to project Greek fire, and Byzantine naval dress
greek-fire-constantinople.scene: A Byzantine oared warship with a bronze tube at its prow spraying a long jet of flame across the water onto an enemy galley, the fire still burning on the waves; sailors in tunics working a pump behind the tube

great-bombard-constantinople.research_focus: the 1453 Ottoman siege of Constantinople, Orban's giant bronze bombard on its timber bed, the Theodosian land walls and Ottoman gunners' dress
great-bombard-constantinople.scene: An enormous bronze cannon lying on a bed of heavy timbers, its barrel wide enough for a man to crawl into, with turbaned gunners rolling a huge stone ball toward its mouth and tall triple city walls in the distance; the gun is a single massive barrel with no wheels

leonardo-armoured-car.research_focus: Leonardo da Vinci's armoured car design, its conical wooden shell and ring of light cannon, and a 1480s Milanese workshop
leonardo-armoured-car.scene: A wooden model of a round, cone-roofed armoured vehicle like an upturned shallow bowl, small cannon barrels poking out all around its rim and a little turret on top, standing on a Renaissance workshop table among compasses and gear wheels; a robed, bearded figure seen from behind leans over it

nagashino-matchlock-volleys.research_focus: the 1575 Battle of Nagashino, ashigaru foot soldiers with tanegashima matchlocks, their conical jingasa helmets and the wooden palisades
nagashino-matchlock-volleys.scene: Ranks of Japanese foot soldiers in conical helmets firing matchlock guns through a rough timber fence, smoke rolling forward, the front rank kneeling to reload while the next rank aims; mounted samurai charging toward the fence in the distance

puckle-gun-patented.research_focus: James Puckle's 1718 Defence Gun, its tripod, single barrel and hand-cranked revolving cylinder, and early Georgian London dress
puckle-gun-patented.scene: A brass-and-iron flintlock gun on a tall tripod, with one long barrel and a fat revolving cylinder turned by a crank handle at the back, a gentleman in a full wig and long coat demonstrating it in a London yard; it is a single-barrelled gun on three legs, not a wheeled cannon

first-aerial-bombing-libya.research_focus: the 1911 Italo-Turkish War in Libya, the Etrich Taube monoplane with its bird-shaped wings, and early aviator dress
first-aerial-bombing-libya.scene: A fragile early monoplane with bird-like wings and an open cockpit flying low over a desert oasis camp, the pilot in a leather cap and goggles leaning over the side to drop a grenade the size of an orange by hand

thompson-submachine-gun.research_focus: the Thompson M1921 submachine gun, its round drum magazine, finned barrel and twin wooden grips, and 1920s gun shop fittings
thompson-submachine-gun.scene: A Thompson submachine gun with a round drum magazine, a wooden stock and two wooden pistol grips lying in an open fitted carrying case on a 1920s shop counter, a spare drum beside it; no people

spitfire-first-flight.research_focus: the Spitfire prototype K5054 at Eastleigh aerodrome in 1936, its elliptical wings, and 1930s British airfield ground crew dress
spitfire-first-flight.scene: A sleek single-engined monoplane fighter with broad, rounded elliptical wings lifting off a grass airfield, its wheels just leaving the ground, a few ground crew in overalls watching from beside a hangar; the wings curve to rounded tips, not squared ones

dambusters-bouncing-bombs.research_focus: the 1943 Dambusters raid, Lancaster bombers at very low level, the cylindrical Upkeep bouncing bomb and the Möhne dam
dambusters-bouncing-bombs.scene: A four-engined bomber skimming a moonlit reservoir at tree-top height, a barrel-shaped bomb skipping across the water ahead of it in a line of splashes toward a long stone dam with two towers; the bomb is a drum-shaped cylinder, not a finned bomb

me-262-jet-fighter-combat.research_focus: the Messerschmitt Me 262 in 1944, its swept wings and two underslung jet engine pods, and Allied propeller bombers of the period
me-262-jet-fighter-combat.scene: A shark-nosed fighter with swept-back wings and a jet engine pod under each wing streaking past a formation of propeller-driven bombers high above the clouds; the fighter has no propeller

ak-47-designed.research_focus: the first-model AK-47 of the late 1940s, its curved magazine, wooden stock and handguard, and a Soviet arms workshop bench
ak-47-designed.scene: An assault rifle with a wooden stock, a wooden handguard and a long curved magazine lying on a workshop bench among files, calipers and loose machined parts, a second rifle half-assembled beside it; no people

b-52-enters-service.research_focus: the B-52 Stratofortress in the mid-1950s, its swept wings, tall tail fin and eight engines in four paired pods, and a US air base flight line
b-52-enters-service.scene: A vast swept-wing bomber on a concrete flight line, eight jet engines hung in four paired pods under its drooping wings and a tall tail fin behind, ground crew in 1950s overalls dwarfed beside its wheels

m16-rifle-adopted.research_focus: the early M16 rifle of the mid-1960s, its carrying handle, triangular handguard and straight magazine, and 1960s US Army jungle fatigues
m16-rifle-adopted.scene: A slim rifle with a carrying handle on top, a ribbed triangular handguard and a short straight magazine, held across the chest of an anonymous soldier in a 1960s helmet and fatigues wading through tall jungle grass, his face in shadow; beside him another soldier carries an older, heavier wooden-stocked rifle

f-117-stealth-fighter-service.research_focus: the F-117 Nighthawk, its faceted flat-panelled airframe and V-shaped tail, and a desert air base hangar at night
f-117-stealth-fighter-service.scene: An angular jet made entirely of flat, faceted panels like a cut gemstone, with a sharp pointed nose and a V-shaped tail, rolling out of a hangar onto a desert runway at night; no people

b-2-stealth-bomber-first-flight.research_focus: the B-2 Spirit's 1989 first flight from Palmdale, its tailless flying-wing shape with a sawtooth trailing edge, over the Mojave desert
b-2-stealth-bomber-first-flight.scene: A huge smooth flying-wing aircraft with no tail and no fuselage, its trailing edge cut in a sawtooth, climbing over a dry desert landscape with its landing gear still down; no people

patriot-missiles-scuds.research_focus: the 1991 Gulf War, Patriot missile launchers with their boxy four-canister units on trailers, and night skies over Gulf cities
patriot-missiles-scuds.scene: A boxy angled launcher on a truck trailer in the desert at night firing a missile on a bright trail that curves up toward a second streak falling from the sky, a city skyline low on the horizon; no people

predator-drone-first-hellfire.research_focus: the MQ-1 Predator drone, its bulbous nose, long thin wings, downward V-tail and rear propeller, carrying Hellfire missiles, over a desert test range
predator-drone-first-hellfire.scene: A slender windowless aircraft with a bulbous nose, long thin straight wings, a downward-pointing V-shaped tail and a propeller at the back, launching a small missile from under its wing over an empty desert range; there is no cockpit and no pilot

mother-of-all-bombs-combat.research_focus: the GBU-43/B MOAB, its long cylindrical body and lattice grid fins, released on a cradle from the rear ramp of an MC-130 transport over mountains
mother-of-all-bombs-combat.scene: A very long, fat cylindrical bomb with a pointed nose and lattice grid fins sliding off a cradle out of the open rear ramp of a four-engined propeller transport plane, a small parachute pulling it clear, bare mountain ridges far below; no people
